summary: Complete performance testing of NewDealPage rewrite and ReferenceDataPage optimization. All performance improvements verified: 1) Rapid typing in Client Name field - no lag (1.52s for 40 chars with 20ms delay), 2) All dropdowns (Transaction Type, Transfer Type, Buy/Sell Currency) open/close instantly, 3) Calendar date pickers open/close smoothly, 4) Bank/Crypto toggles on all 3 sections (From, To, Ours) switch instantly with fields updating correctly, 5) Currency Amount x Rate auto-calculation works in real-time, 6) Full deal submission with confirmation dialog showing all entered data, 7) ReferenceDataPage tab switching smooth with RefRow memo components, 8) Edit/Delete buttons work correctly on reference items.
